# Druid 10.3 - Latest Deployment Dates The table below lists the deployment date of the latest release, Druid 10.3 across Druid Clouds. To view the Druid Releases Calendar, see [Druid Releases](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/13_Release%20Notes/Druid%20AI%20Releases.htm). | Druid Cloud Community
\*.community.Druidplatform.com | Druid Cloud US
\*.us.Druidplatform.com | Druid Cloud Australia
\*au.Druidplatform.com | Druid Cloud West-Europe (PROD)
\*.Druidplatform.com | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | November 05, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | These release notes give you a brief, high-level description of the improvements implemented to existing features. If you have questions about your Druid tenant, please contact [support@druidai.com](mailto:support@druidai.com) or your local Druid partner for more information. ## What's New - **Agent Mandate – Generally Available**. Agent Mandate is now generally available, enabling organizations to build goal-driven AI Agents that autonomously determine how to accomplish business tasks using the capabilities available to them. With an agentic-first approach, you can define what an AI Agent should achieve, establish its responsibilities and operational guidelines, and equip it with the tools needed to interact with enterprise systems and execute business operations. The dedicated Mandate Editor simplifies agent development by bringing instructions, tools, and LLM configuration into a single interface, reducing configuration complexity and development effort. ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/Agent%20mandate/Agent%20Mandate.png) By shifting the focus from predefined conversational paths to business outcomes, Agent Mandate helps organizations accelerate AI Agent development, simplify maintenance, and build more adaptable AI-driven business processes. For more information, see [Agent Mandate](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/4_Flows/Agent%20Mandate.htm). - AI Agent **Avatar**. Druid now supports interactive AI Agent video avatars, enabling organizations to deliver more engaging, personalized, and human-like customer interactions. ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/Agent%20avatar/avatar%20on%20start.png)![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/Agent%20avatar/avatar2.png) You can configure an AI Agent avatar directly from the websnippet customization settings, select its appearance, define its behavior, and customize the controls that allow users to switch between avatar, voice, and text chat modes. For more information, see [AI Agent Avatar](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/AI%20Agent%20Avatar.htm). **NOTE:**Currently, HeyGen is the only supported avatar provider. For enhanced security, Druid uses HeyGen exclusively for the visual avatar experience, while voice communication is handled through Druid Voice, requiring Druid SIP connectivity. - **SIP Codec Negotiation & Priority Order**. Druid SIP now supports configurable codec prioritization, giving you greater control over how supported audio codecs are advertised during SIP SDP negotiation. You can customize the priority order of supported codecs based on your audio quality, bandwidth, and compatibility requirements. Druid provides a recommended default order, which you can easily rearrange or restore at any time. For more information, see [SIP Codec Negotiation & Priority Order](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Druid%20Voice/Configure%20Druid%20SIP%20Connectivity.htm#SIP). ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/Druid%20Voice/sip%20codecs1.png) - **Connector Designer - Support Condition Values from Local Scope Entities**. You can now evaluate conditions directly against entities defined within a local scope using the standard \[\[Entity\]\].Field syntax (for example, \[\[Patient\]\].IsActive == true). This enhancement removes the requirement for custom code loops and workarounds, allowing flow logic to run efficiently across integration steps using the data available in the current scope. ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/druid%2010.3/local%20variable%20conditions.png) - **Flows - New SwitchIntent internal action**. Introduced for the Agent Mandate, the **SwitchIntent** internal action also streamlines AI Agent authoring and intent handling. This action searches for an intent matching the user's request and automatically switches to it when a match is found. It simplifies workflows by eliminating the need to use internal actions such as GetIntentMatching or GetMegaBotIntentMatching and manual conditional routing. For more information, see [SwitchIntent](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/4_Flows/Internal%20Actions.htm#SwitchIn). - **Web Views - User-level sorting persistence**. Updated web views sorting behavior so that custom column sorting choices are saved at the user level rather. Your sorting preferences are now persisted across sessions, meaning your customized view is preserved automatically the next time you log in. - **Knowledge Base - AsciiDoc rendering for Normal view**. Added rich AsciiDoc rendering support for extracted document records when viewing them in **Normal view**. Raw markup syntax and structure blocks are now dynamically compiled into clean headers, structured lists, and organized HTML tables, significantly improving readability while keeping the **Compressed view** lightweight and unparsed. _Normal view_ ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/druid%2010.3/normal%20view.png) _Compressed view_ ![](https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Resources/Images/druid%2010.3/compressed.png) ## Bug Fixes - **Instagram Channel fix**. Fixed the handling for Instagram Collaboration post events to match existing story mention features. The integration now maps relevant interaction data to \[\[ConversationInfo\]\].InstagramEvent with a dedicated event value, enabling flows to condition logic on Collaboration posts. - **SIP Channel - Fixed credential repopulation issue**. Resolved a bug in the SIP channel configuration where clearing and saving the Username and Password fields resulted in them automatically repopulating upon reloading the page. The system now correctly retains an empty state when credentials are removed and saved. Top
